Remove a named agent (its home stays in the Cua Volume), or stop a run and delete its record (secrets included)

Usage: cua agent rm [OPTIONS] <NAME|SANDBOX> [RUN_ID]

Arguments:
  <NAME|SANDBOX>
          A named agent, a sandbox, or `session:NAME` for a durable session

  [RUN_ID]
          The run (not for a session)

Options:
      --local
          Look NAME up among local sandboxes only (same as `local:NAME`)

      --embedded
          Use an embedded runtime even when a daemon runs

      --daemon <DAEMON>
          Daemon address (socket path or loopback URL)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON=]

      --daemon-token <DAEMON_TOKEN>
          Daemon token (loopback URLs)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON_TOKEN]

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Sandbox state directory (embedded; default ~/.cua/sandboxes)

      --json
          Print JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help

Examples:
  cua agent rm ada
  cua agent rm local:dev run-1a2b3c4d
  cua agent rm session:refactor
